payload.title: concept_card vectors for every accepted concept
payload.description:
src/papyrus_knowledge_query/vector_index.py: add vectorKind concept_card for every accepted SemanticNode (text from knowledge_wiki/pages.py entity_body: displayName, aliases, kind label, description). Metadata kind=semanticNode, vectorKind, nodeKey, nodeKind, lineageId, hashtag. Today only concepts with an AI profile are findable.
Cost (real constraint): text-embedding-3-small, ~$0.02 per million tokens. Sync is idempotent (skip unchanged by content hash).
Tests: sync writes one card per accepted concept and skips unchanged ones.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
